title: Automatically Reference All Tipper Axes Using Operator Station HMI (RESET → AUTO REF → AUTO → CYCLE START)
summary: Use the operator station HMI to automatically reference all tipper axes. Confirm referencing completes when the 'R' icons turn green, then press AUTO and restart operation with CYCLE START.
when_to_use: When tipper axes need automatic referencing so the system can resume operation.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (operator station HMI)

visual_references.description: Operator station HMI screen used for referencing axes (shows the automatic referencing controls and 'R' icons behavior).
Operator Station Control Panel (Visu_MCP_Dual screen) showing AUTO and CYCLE START controls and active button indicators.

steps.title: Press RESET on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Initiate the automatic referencing sequence for the tipper axes.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, press RESET.
steps.expected_result: The automatic referencing sequence is initiated (next step is AUTO REF to reference all tipper axes).
steps.healthy_condition: The HMI is ready to proceed to AUTO REF for referencing.
steps.failure_condition: RESET does not initiate the referencing workflow (cannot proceed to a referencing state).

steps.title: Press AUTO REF to reference all tipper axes
steps.purpose: Start automatic referencing of all tipper axes.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers.
steps.expected_result: Referencing begins for all tipper axes and the 'R' icons will indicate completion.
steps.healthy_condition: The HMI shows the 'R' icons associated with referencing.
steps.failure_condition: Referencing does not progress (no indication of 'R' icons changing during the referencing process).

actions.label: Press AUTO REF
actions.exact_action: Press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers.

source_evidence.quote: 2. Press AUTO REF to reference all of the axes of the tippers. The 'R' icons will turn green when referencing is completed.

steps.title: Confirm referencing completion by verifying 'R' icons turn green
steps.purpose: Ensure referencing completed successfully before switching to AUTO and restarting.
steps.instruction: Watch the 'R' icons on the operator station HMI and confirm they turn green when referencing is completed.
steps.expected_result: The 'R' icons turn green indicating referencing is completed.
steps.failure_condition: The 'R' icons do not turn green (referencing not completed).

actions.label: Verify 'R' icons
actions.exact_action: The 'R' icons will turn green when referencing is completed.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the 'R' icons do not turn green, stop and escalate for support rather than continuing to AUTO/CYCLE START.

source_evidence.quote: The 'R' icons will turn green when referencing is completed.

steps.title: Press AUTO after referencing completes
steps.purpose: Place the tipper system into AUTO mode after successful referencing.
steps.instruction: After referencing is completed (after the 'R' icons turn green), press AUTO on the operator station HMI.
steps.expected_result: AUTO is engaged after referencing completes.
steps.healthy_condition: AUTO mode is active (AUTO control is engaged/ready for cycle start).
steps.failure_condition: AUTO cannot be engaged after referencing completion.

actions.label: Press AUTO
actions.exact_action: When referencing is completed, press AUTO.

source_evidence.quote: 3. When referencing is completed, press AUTO.

steps.title: Press CYCLE START to restart operation
steps.purpose: Restart the tipper operation cycle after AUTO mode is engaged.
steps.instruction: Press CYCLE START on the operator station HMI to restart operation.
steps.expected_result: Operation restarts (cycle start command issued) after AUTO is engaged.
steps.healthy_condition: CYCLE START initiates the operation cycle.
steps.failure_condition: CYCLE START does not restart operation.

actions.label: Press CYCLE START
actions.exact_action: Press CYCLE START to restart operation.

source_evidence.quote: 4. Press CYCLE START to restart operation.

success_criteria: The 'R' icons turn green indicating referencing is completed.
AUTO is engaged after referencing completes.
healthy_conditions: All 'R' icons are green after AUTO REF referencing completes.
failure_conditions: The 'R' icons do not turn green (referencing not completed).
AUTO cannot be engaged after referencing completes.
CYCLE START does not restart operation.
escalation_guidance: If the 'R' icons do not turn green, stop and escalate for support rather than continuing to AUTO/CYCLE START.
